cover: The cover of Distributed Systems from the Ground Up. On a stormy night 5 lighthouses stand on rocks in the sea, each kept by a crab, and beams of light join their lamps into a ring. Lightning strikes one lighthouse: its lamp is dark, its beams are broken, and its crab is shocked. The other 4 lamps still shine, and a paper boat carrying the word PUT sails safely between them. A sign reads: 4 of 5 still agree.
ch01: Draft, an owl, stands beside a drawing board. The blueprint on it shows a request passing through a router to a group of 3 nodes, one of them marked as the leader. A crab looks up at the board.
ch02: Ledger, a tortoise, writes each change in a long ledger before saying yes. Lightning strikes beside it and a crab jumps in shock, and the ledger still holds every line that was written: put user-1, put user-2, delete user-2.
ch03: Ledger the tortoise sits at the first of 3 ledgers. 2 pigeons carry copies of its newest line to the other 2 ledgers. The first ledger shows lines 1 to 3 ticked, and the other 2 ledgers show the same lines.
ch04: 3 cats sit in boxes numbered 1, 2 and 3. The cat in box 3 wears a small crown, and the other 2 cats each hold up a paper marked with a tick. A ballot box stands between them under a banner that reads term 1.
ch05: Switch, an octopus, sits between 2 stacks of boxes marked shard-a and shard-b. It holds a parcel labelled user-1 in one arm and points another arm at shard-a.
ch06: Bundle, a beaver, carries 4 logs tied together with a rope toward a door marked disk, where a single log lies that was carried alone. A crab watches with a stopwatch.
ch07: Toll, a gnu, stands beside a sign that reads: 5 per second, burst of 10.
ch08: Stamp, a squirrel, stands beside a sign that reads: time, node, counter.
ch09: Recall, an elephant, stands beside a sign that reads: keep what was used last.
ch10: Latch, a hermit crab, stands beside a sign that reads: token 1, token 2, the lower one is refused.
ch11: 2 pigeons stand beside a sign that lists offsets 0, 1 and 2, with a mark at the committed one.
ch12: Shift, a small daemon, stands beside a sign that reads: waiting, running, done.
ch13: Chime, a penguin, stands beside a sign that lists pauses of 1, 2, 4 and 8 seconds.
ch14: Dash, a hare, stands beside a sign that reads: 1000000 becomes 4C92.
ch15: Echo, an owl, stands beside a sign that reads: copy on write, or collect on read.
ch16: Crate, a gopher, stands beside a sign that reads: 10 MB, 3 chunks, 3 copies of each.
ch17: A whale swims beside a sign that reads: 4 seconds at a time, in 4 qualities.
ch18: 2 pigeons stand beside a sign that lists messages 1 to 4 and the words: last received 1.
ch19: A tortoise stands beside a sign that reads: minus 40, plus 40, total 0.
ch20: A cat sits in a box numbered 12 beside a sign that reads: held for 5 minutes, then sold or free.
ch21: A hare stands beside a sign that shows a grid of 9 squares with the middle one marked.
ch22: An owl stands beside a sign that reads: ka, then kafka, karaoke, kayak.
ch23: An octopus stands beside a sign that reads: 1 queue per host, wait 2 seconds, never twice.
ch24: An owl stands beside a sign that reads: 40, plus 2, minus 3, plus 1.
ch25: A beaver stands beside a sign that reads: based on version 3, now version 4.
ch26: 2 penguins stand beside a sign that reads: cat, chat, cats, chats.
ch27: A squirrel stands beside a sign that reads: sell 1005, buy 1000, no trade yet.
ch28: A hare stands beside a sign that reads: happened at 7, arrived at 13, counted at 7.
